node.title: Token Intelligence — trace AI spend to outcomes
node.summary: Traces token consumption and classifies it productive / inefficient / wasteful, attributing spend to people, teams, and the outcomes it delivered.
node.interview_question: How do you actually attribute a token to an outcome, and where does that attribution become an estimate rather than a fact?

competitor.name: Harness
competitor.positioning: Harness AI DLC Insights markets the same 'see what your AI tokens shipped' join and is the #1 watch-list threat to this exact card.
